newsitem.title: UK: Somerfield eases as results fail to excite.
newsitem.headline: Somerfield eases as results fail to excite.

text.p: Shares in supermarket group Somerfield Plc fell as the market called a halt to the stock's steady ascent ahead of results.
"The profits were less than expected on a proforma basis and people don't believe the story long-term," said one analyst.

"The question has been: can they do enough to revitalise a very compromised portfolio of stores, to stop the business going backwards? At the moment it looks as though they can but against market conditions which are not very competitive," he said.

Earlier, Somerfield said its first set of yearly results since flotation showed actual pre-tax profit of 105.4 million stg, with proforma pre-tax profit at 101.6 million compared with analysts' expectations of 101.9-105 million.
